source: St Abaddon concealed the location of his Revelations. He was weak, driven mad by the few visions he saw there, and he fled. However, his writings contained enough accidental clues that I was able to retrace his tentative first step along the Golden Path.<NL>I did not wish to succumb to the same weakness, so I had myself sealed in the cave - I would instead transcend fear and experience deeper revelation. The Well of Visions thus revealed to me mysterious truths of the world that only the initiated can see.<NL>The foundation of our brotherhood is this: there is no heaven, only this world and an eternity of hells beyond. We must forge the world we desire from the iron of our will. Blood is the vessel of this will.<NL>One must master the conscious and subconscious mind to master will. Mystic meditation reveals the influence of false rules of social convention on the subconscious. source: To: Staff Sergeant Bruno Pastore, Chief of Operations, Forward Base Milan<NL><NL>Caro Bruno,<NL><NL>How’s things out west? I’d ask if you were enjoying the spring weather, but I know you’re too much of a miserable bastard to care. Still, sounds like there might be some news to make even you smile... is it true you’ve got some of your old buddies from the Survivor Brigade rotating through this season? You might finally make a dent in the Genoa horde, if so. Best of luck to you. It’s the same old, same old here in Venice: mosquitoes, shit-smelling water, and dead guys who can’t even find their way out of the canals. Frankly, I could use a challenge - so feel free to send any spare action my way, if you’re feeling charitably inclined towards your old pal. <NL><NL>Bacha ma culo, <NL><NL>Chf Sam Dutton, Forward Base Venice<END>

source: I had dismissed reports of “zombie planes” above Venice as part of the same hysteria behind the “zombie shark” rumours. Nevertheless, if what we’ve observed among the mechanical detritus here is real, and not a shared hallucination, I may have to reassess. It seems whatever pseudospiritual reaniminative force is at work here may no longer be restricted to biological remains. We’ve had to move on before I can draw conclusions, but if you could find the time to make a few notes, I’d be most grateful.<NL><NL>- Efram Schweiger<END>

source: If my suspicions are correct (and I pray they are not, although prayer seems to be of ever-decreasing use), we are faced here with a scenario far darker even than Hitler’s unleashing of the dead during the war. As I warned at the time, his supposed mastery was no more than meddling - what success he enjoyed was largely accidental. This time, it seems the reanimative force is being channelled with terrible, calculated purpose - and yet I can’t shake the feeling that he is tied in with it still.<END>

source: THE FALL OF THE FÜHRER<NL><NL>As a man, the Führer had many flaws. It was these flaws which have led us to this point, with Germany in ruins, its armies destroyed and its enemies marching victorious across its borders.<NL><NL>We followed him and believed in him, knowing all this would happen. Knowing, in fact, that it had to happen. <NL><NL>In desperation, trapped in his bunker, the Führer would unleash his most terrible weapon on his enemies. The dead would rise, to fall upon the living.<NL><NL>It was a true madman's gambit, and one that would turn on the madman who used it. For one great sacrifice was required for the Golden Age to happen.<NL><NL>The Führer himself had to die.<END>
